author: Inside Edition
description: Ask almost any New Yorker, and they'll tell you the Knicks' NBA championship run was unforgettable. But some fans of the team are making sure they'll never, ever forget Jalen Brunson and company, by getting Knicks tattoos. Melissa Belazoto told WCBS, "I think it's  just time for it to be set in stone, set in my skin." The team will cap its incredible season with a ticker tape parade this Thursday in downtown's Canyon of Heroes.
title: Knicks Fans Are Getting Tattoos To Never Forget Championship Season

author: Inside Edition
description: The women who work at this cafe all have one thing in common: they're survivors of acid attacks. It's called Sheroes Hangout, and it's found in the Indian city of Agra, home to the Taj Mahal. But in the shadow of one of the world's most famous landmarks, something special is going on at Sheroes. Employees at the hangout told reporters it's helping them live life on their own terms. The cafe manager said that it grew out of an initiative called "Stop Acid Attack."
title: Acid Attack Survivors Staff Sheroes Hangout
